setup_notes: Fork main fast-forwarded to upstream and pushed. `--stats` flag does not exist at this HEAD; per-stage timings were taken with the debug build's `--trace`. In `make test-race`, three ls/corpus TestSignatureConfigs subtests timed out (60s, 'missing response ID') under full-suite load; no DATA RACE was reported, and the test passes with -race in isolation on both main and the branch (out-of-scope LS flake).

hypotheses.title: Intersection of K record types is ~O(K^3): mappingFormulaIsEmpty re-folds every positive atom from scratch at each BDD leaf
hypotheses.issue: For `type Combined T0 & T1 & ... & T{K-1};` over open records, stage 4 (top-level type resolution) and stage 6 (semantic analysis) grow ~cubically in K (doubling K -> ~6x time, ~8x allocations). Root cause: semtypes/mapping_ops.go mappingFormulaIsEmpty, called by the BDD emptiness walk with the conjunction list of positive atoms on the current path, folds ALL positive atoms with intersectMapping from scratch at every leaf, so paths that share a positive prefix (R0∧R1∧…∧Rk), within one emptiness check and across checks, recompute the same prefix intersections. Each intersectMapping step walks every field of the growing combined atom (O(k) per step, O(k^2) per leaf) and re-interns each field cell via intersectMemberSemTypes -> cellContainingWithEnvSemTypeCellMutability -> env.typeAtom (env mutex + new BDD node) even when the intersected cell equals an input cell (field ∩ anydata rest). Stage 4 multiplies this because resolveBTypeInner (case *ast.BLangIntersectionTypeNode) runs ensureNotEmpty(Intersect(lhs,rhs)) for each of the K-1 binary `&` nodes (deferred to drainDeferredEmptinessChecks) on growing prefixes; stage 6 pays it again in validateMappingConstructor -> IsSubtype(ctorTy, Combined), whose diff BDD has ~K paths each re-folding the prefix. Allocation hot spots inside the fold: intersectMapping appends to un-presized names/types slices, and mappingPairIterator.internalNext (semtypes/field_pair.go) heap-allocates every fieldPair via new(...) — together ~93% of bytes allocated on the reproducer.

reproducer.generator:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a valid Ballerina program whose type `Combined` is the intersection
of K open record "trait" types: `type Combined T0 & T1 & ... & T{K-1};`.
Usage: gen_intersection.py K > out.bal"""
import sys
k = int(sys.argv[1])
L = ["import ballerina/io;", ""]
for i in range(k):
    L.append(f"type T{i} record {{ int f{i}; }};")
L.append("")
L.append("type Combined " + " & ".join(f"T{i}" for i in range(k)) + ";")
L.append("")
L.append("function sum(Combined c) returns int {")
L.append("    return " + " + ".join(f"c.f{i}" for i in range(k)) + ";")
L.append("}")
L.append("")
L.append("public function main() {")
L.append("    Combined c = {" + ", ".join(f"f{i}: {i}" for i in range(k)) + "};")
L.append("    io:println(sum(c));")
L.append("}")
print("\n".join(L))
reproducer.command: python3 gen_intersection.py 200 > intersection_200.bal && go build -o bal ./cli/cmd && hyperfine -N -w 1 -r 5 './bal run intersection_200.bal'  # per-stage: go build -tags debug -o bal-debug ./cli/cmd && ./bal-debug run --trace=t.json --memprofile m.prof intersection_200.bal

hypotheses.fix_approach: (1) mappingFormulaIsEmpty now computes the positive-atom intersection via a recursive mappingConjunctionIntersection that folds from the end of the conjunction list (the BDD root side) and memoises each pairwise intersectMapping in a per-semtypes.Context map keyed by (*MappingAtomicType, *MappingAtomicType) (nil value = known empty), cleared in Context.Reset. Paths sharing a prefix, within one emptiness check and across checks, now reuse the prefix result, so each leaf costs one intersectMapping instead of k. Fold order changes are safe because mapping intersection is commutative and intersectMapping merges fields by sorted name. Pointer-identity keys are valid because atom types are immutable once interned; the memo must not outlive the context (the env is shared). (2) intersectMemberSemTypes returns an input cell unchanged when the intersected cell has the same type and mutability (avoids env.typeAtom interning). (3) intersectMapping pre-sizes names/types; mappingPairIterator yields fieldPair by value instead of heap-allocating it. The per-`&` emptiness checks in stage 4 were left as-is (changing them would move the diagnostic position for empty inner intersections); after (1) they are cheap because each prefix check reuses the memoised intersections. The recursion depth equals the number of positive atoms on a path; an iterative version would avoid deep stacks for very large K.

notes: Exploration also saw superlinear behaviour in already-reported areas (nested loop/closure resolver chains, sequential loops' capture entries, unions of N error types being exponential, object inclusion chains); not re-reported. A worse variant of H1 (records sharing a required field plus distinct optional fields, `type Ri record { int a; string bi?; }`) took 9s at N=200 on main; not measured on the branch.
